敵方靈體宣告攻擊時，使該攻擊靈體攻擊力降低700直到回合結束；不取消攻擊。同名卡: When an enemy Spirit declares an attack, lower that attacker's ATK by 700 until turn end. The attack is not cancelled. Once per turn per card name.
敵方靈體宣告攻擊時，使該攻擊靈體攻擊力降低700直到回合結束；不取消攻擊: When an enemy Spirit declares an attack, lower its ATK by 700 until turn end; the attack continues.
路口那塊不太起眼的石碑，寄託著人們平安回家的願望。石敢當的名字，說的正是挺身擋在: That modest stone tablet at the crossroads holds people's wish for a safe journey home. Shigandang's name speaks of the strength to step forward and stand in harm's way.
民間常在道路直衝的屋前或巷口安置石敢當，祈求擋煞、保護家宅。它可能是一方刻字石碑: People often place Shigandang where a road points straight at a house or at an alley entrance, hoping to ward off evil and protect their homes. It may be a carved stone tablet or carry lion or tiger decorations.
《神籙》將石碑的守護意象化成石甲靈體。這副能站起來迎敵的身軀，是遊戲創作；牠接下: Shenlu turns the tablet's protective meaning into a stone-armored Spirit. Its body that rises to face enemies is a game creation; the way it takes danger carries on the wish to guard the home.
下次經過老街，可以看看路口、屋角是否藏著刻字石碑。不同造型都承載相似的願望：讓家: Next time you walk through an old street, look for carved tablets at crossroads or house corners. Their shapes differ, but the wish is much the same: a peaceful life for those at home.
石敢當常立在巷口或屋前，寄託擋煞、守護家宅的願望。《神籙》讓石碑化為石甲靈體，替: Shigandang often stands at alley entrances or before houses as a wish to ward off evil and protect the home. In Shenlu, the tablet becomes a stone-armored Spirit that takes danger for its companions.
迎風站在村落邊的風獅爺，是金門很有辨識度的守護形象。牠的目光越過屋瓦，彷彿一直留: The Wind Lion God facing the wind at a village's edge is a familiar guardian of Kinmen. Its gaze reaches beyond the roof tiles, as though always watching the distance.
金門的風獅爺與鎮風、擋煞的信仰有關，常見石雕獅子的模樣。各村的姿態、表情與裝飾並: Kinmen's Wind Lion Gods are tied to beliefs in calming winds and warding off harm. They often look like stone lions. Different villages give them their own poses, faces and decorations.
《神籙》讓風獅爺守護隊伍立足的場地。面對衝向家園的威脅，牠會先穩住腳步，再替同伴: In Shenlu, the Wind Lion God guards the ground where the group stands. When danger charges toward home, it steadies its feet before shielding its companions.
看風獅爺時，除了威武的表情，也可以注意牠安放的位置。村落入口、屋頂與迎風處，都能: When looking at Wind Lion Gods, notice where they stand as well as their fierce faces. Village entrances, rooftops and windy spots show how residents see wind and danger in everyday life.
風獅爺是金門的守護形象，與鎮風、擋煞的信仰相連。各村獅像各有姿態，迎風而立的身影: The Wind Lion God is a guardian figure of Kinmen, linked to calming winds and warding off evil. Each village has its own lion statues, standing against the wind with residents' hopes for a safe home.
廖添丁的故事，經過戲曲、說書與民間傳聞，逐漸成為身手靈巧、替弱者出頭的俠盜形象。: Through theater, storytelling and local tales, Liao Tianding's story grew into that of a nimble outlaw who stood up for the vulnerable.
歷史上的廖添丁生活於日治時期。當時的警方紀錄與後來的民間英雄故事，對他的描寫並不: The historical Liao Tianding lived under Japanese rule. Police records from that time and later folk-hero tales portray him differently. Not every heroic scene onstage can be treated as historical fact.
《神籙》採用民間傳奇中的俠盜形象：來去靈活，擅長接應同伴。退回一步不是丟下夥伴，: Shenlu uses the outlaw of folk legend: quick on his feet and skilled at supporting companions. Taking a step back is not abandoning them, but keeping a chance for the next move.
同一個人物，為什麼會在公文與戲台上留下不同樣貌？廖添丁的故事也讓人看見，民眾如何: Why can one person look so different in official records and onstage? Liao Tianding's stories show how people place their hopes for fairness in legendary heroes.
廖添丁是日治時期的人物，在民間傳奇中成為替弱者出頭的俠盜。《神籙》採用這份俠義形: Liao Tianding lived under Japanese rule and became a champion of the vulnerable in folk legend. Shenlu draws on that heroic image, making him a nimble supporter of his companions.
千里眼是媽祖身旁的護法之一。祂望向遠處的姿態，讓看不見的危險也有了可以提早察覺的: Qianliyan is one of Mazu's guardians. His far-seeing gaze offers a chance to notice danger before it can be seen nearby.
民間傳說中，千里眼替媽祖察看遠方的災難，與聽取四方聲音的順風耳相互配合。神像常以: In folk tales, Qianliyan watches for distant disasters on Mazu's behalf, working with Shunfeng'er, who hears voices from all directions. Statues often show him raising a hand to look far away.
《神籙》把遠望化為尋路與觀察敵勢的本領。祂不需要等到危險貼近，便能提醒同伴做好準: Shenlu turns his distant vision into a gift for finding paths and reading enemy movements. He can warn his companions before danger reaches them.
千里眼與順風耳是一組很容易從姿勢辨認的護法。欣賞廟宇神像時，可以先找遠望的手勢，: Qianliyan and Shunfeng'er are a pair of guardians easily recognized by their poses. In temple statues, look first for the hand raised to see far away, then the gesture of listening closely.
千里眼是媽祖身旁的護法，傳說能察看遠方災難。祂常以舉手遠望的姿態出現，與順風耳一: Qianliyan guards Mazu and is said to see far-off disasters. Often shown with a hand raised to his brow, he works with Shunfeng'er to notice calls for help from many places.
順風耳傾聽四方的呼聲。對祂而言，救援往往從一聲很輕、卻不能忽略的求助開始。: Shunfeng'er listens to voices from every direction. For him, rescue often begins with a quiet plea that must not be missed.
順風耳與千里眼同為媽祖的護法。民間故事賦予祂遠聽的能力，神像也常以手靠耳側的動作: Shunfeng'er and Qianliyan are both guardians of Mazu. Folk tales give him the power to hear across great distances, and statues often show him holding a hand beside his ear as he listens.
《神籙》讓順風耳負責接應與提醒。看見威脅的同時，也要聽見夥伴的需要，隊伍才能彼此: In Shenlu, Shunfeng'er supports and warns the group. Seeing a threat is not enough; listening to companions' needs helps everyone care for one another.
「看」與「聽」一起出現在媽祖信仰裡，讓救苦的形象更具體：先知道哪裡有人需要幫忙，: Seeing and hearing appear together in Mazu worship, making the idea of rescue clearer: learn where help is needed first, and you can find the way there.
順風耳是媽祖身旁的護法，傳說能聽見遠方的聲音。祂與千里眼彼此配合，一位察看、一位: Shunfeng'er is Mazu's guardian, said to hear distant voices. He and Qianliyan work together, one watching and one listening, to help Mazu answer suffering and danger.
虎爺是阿澤踏上旅程時最先相伴的靈體。牠不說話，卻會停下腳步、低吼提醒，也會陪你一: Tiger Lord is the first Spirit to accompany A-Ze on his journey. He does not speak, but pauses and growls to warn of danger, then walks with you into the unknown.
虎爺也稱虎將軍、下壇將軍，是台灣常見的動物神。許多廟宇將祂供奉在主神神龕或供桌下: Tiger Lord is also called the Tiger General or General Beneath the Altar, a common animal deity in Taiwan. Many temples place him beneath the main deity's shrine or offering table as a guardian of the temple.
第一章裡，虎爺踏住廟口石階上的紅繩，讓阿澤注意到旁邊的舊符。紅金領巾與陪伴阿澤的: In chapter 1, Tiger Lord pins the red cord on the temple steps, drawing A-Ze's attention to an old talisman. His red-and-gold neckerchief and adult tiger form beside A-Ze are Shenlu character designs.
廟裡的虎爺常是小巧的雕像，表情也不一定兇猛。牠可以威武，也可以樸拙親切；遊戲則把: Tiger Lord statues in temples are often small and not always fierce. They may look mighty or simple and friendly. The game enlarges that sense of protection into a companion who can stand beside the player.
虎爺又稱虎將軍，是台灣常見的動物神，常供奉於神龕或供桌下方。《神籙》中，牠也是陪: Tiger Lord, also called the Tiger General, is a common animal deity in Taiwan, often worshipped beneath shrines or offering tables. In Shenlu, he joins A-Ze at the start and warns him of danger with a low growl.
媽祖是台灣廣受敬奉的神祇，人們也親切地稱祂為媽祖婆。海上的牽掛與日常的祈願，都能: Mazu is widely worshipped in Taiwan, where people affectionately call her Mazu Po. The name brings together worries for those at sea and hopes for everyday life.
媽祖又稱天上聖母、天妃、天后。千里眼與順風耳陪伴在祂身旁，傳說分別替祂察看災難、: Mazu is also called the Holy Mother of Heaven, Heavenly Consort and Empress of Heaven. Qianliyan and Shunfeng'er accompany her, said to watch for disasters and hear calls for help.
《神籙》中的媽祖顯影提醒阿澤：先守住能讓同伴站穩的地方。這段護送故事是遊戲創作，: Mazu's projection in Shenlu reminds A-Ze to first protect a place where his companions can stand safely. This escort story is fictional, not a reenactment of a particular historical event.
「媽祖」這個稱呼，除了尊敬，也帶著親近感。遊戲用護送與守護來呈現這份心意，讓救人: The name Mazu expresses both respect and closeness. Through escorting and protecting others, the game shows that saving people is about more than winning a duel.
媽祖又稱天上聖母，台灣民間也親切地稱祂為媽祖婆。從海上的航行到日常生活，人們向祂: Mazu, also called the Holy Mother of Heaven, is affectionately known in Taiwan as Mazu Po. From sea voyages to daily life, people pray to her for safety, carrying hopes for their families and the way home.
鄭成功是與台南、安平歷史密切相關的人物。城牆與港口留下的記憶，也成為《神籙》城壘: Koxinga, or Zheng Chenggong, is closely tied to the history of Tainan and Anping. Memories held by the walls and harbor inspired Shenlu's fortress chapter.
鄭成功於十七世紀率軍來台，與荷蘭東印度公司交戰，之後建立鄭氏在台的政權。認識這段: In the 17th century, Koxinga led forces to Taiwan, fought the Dutch East India Company and then established Zheng rule there. Castles, local development and the experiences of different residents offer ways to explore this history.
城壘篇中的鄭成功是神籙映出的角色，協助阿澤思考如何替同伴留下通路。關卡中的封閉城: The Koxinga in the fortress chapter is a figure projected by Shenlu, helping A-Ze think about keeping a passage open for companions. The closed gates and rescue scenes are not reenactments of history.
遊戲裡打開城門，不只是擊敗守衛，也是在問：後面的同伴走得過來嗎？這是本作對突破與: Opening a gate in the game is about more than defeating its guards. It also asks whether the companions behind you can get through. That is Shenlu's view of breaking through and supporting others.
鄭成功是十七世紀率軍來台、與安平歷史密切相關的人物。《神籙》以城壘與港口為創作背: Koxinga led forces to Taiwan in the 17th century and is closely connected with Anping's history. Drawing on fortresses and harbors, Shenlu lets his figure lead companions through obstacles.
安平的巷弄裡，劍獅常守在門首或牆上。口中銜劍的模樣，把守住家宅的心願留在每天進出: Sword Lions often guard doorways and walls in Anping's alleys. Holding a sword in their mouths, they keep the wish to protect the home at the places people pass each day.
劍獅是安平具代表性的文化形象，帶有祈福、辟邪與守護家園的意涵。許多造型原本與民宅: The Sword Lion is a cultural symbol of Anping, carrying wishes for blessings, protection from evil and a safe home. Many forms were part of houses themselves, not statues displayed on their own.
《神籙》把門牆上的守護者化為能上場的靈體。牠願意替夥伴承受打擊，延續了「危險到門: Shenlu turns this guardian of doorways and walls into a playable Spirit. It takes blows for companions, carrying on the idea that danger reaching the door will meet a protector.
欣賞劍獅時，可以連同門框、牆面與巷道一起看。守護形象和居民的房子連在一起，也是地: Look at a Sword Lion together with its doorframe, wall and alley. The guardian is part of residents' homes and the memories of local life.
劍獅常見於台南安平的門首與牆面，口中銜劍，寄託辟邪、守護家宅的願望。《神籙》讓這: Sword Lions commonly appear over doors and on walls in Anping, Tainan. Their swords express hopes to ward off evil and protect homes. In Shenlu, the guardian steps down from the wall to stand beside companions.
風雞保留公雞挺立的輪廓，是金門烈嶼很有特色的守護形象。牠站在風裡，也站在人們盼望: With the proud outline of a rooster, the Wind Rooster is a distinctive guardian of Lieyu in Kinmen. It stands in the wind where people place their hopes for peace.
烈嶼的風雞信仰與鎮風、擋煞的願望有關。常見白色公雞造型，安放於聚落周邊或屋脊，是: Lieyu's Wind Rooster worship is tied to calming winds and warding off harm. Usually shaped as a white rooster, it stands around villages or on roof ridges as part of local life and belief.
《神籙》讓風雞像報曉一樣，替隊伍帶來新的方向。牠的角色重點在於引路與準備，而不是: In Shenlu, the Wind Rooster offers a new direction like a rooster announcing dawn. Its role centers on guidance and preparation rather than simply overpowering enemies.
公雞報曉、啄食蟲子的日常形象，如何成為村落守護的象徵？風雞讓平凡動物與地方居民的: How did the everyday rooster, crowing at dawn and pecking at insects, become a village guardian? The Wind Rooster links an ordinary animal with local people's hopes.
風雞是金門烈嶼的地方守護形象，常見白色公雞造型，安放在聚落周邊或屋脊。牠迎風挺立: The Wind Rooster is a local guardian of Lieyu, Kinmen, usually a white rooster placed around villages or on roof ridges. Standing against the wind, it carries hopes of calm weather, protection from harm and peace.
石塔不必開口，站在聚落邊就是一種陪伴。層層石塊堆起的不只是高度，也承接居民對安穩: A Stone Pagoda needs no words to be a companion at the village edge. Its layers of stone carry more than height; they hold residents' hopes for a steady, peaceful life.
澎湖可見作為祈福、擋煞用途的石塔。例如小門村中營石塔，地方口述便將建塔與保佑村落: Penghu has stone pagodas used to seek blessings and ward off harm. Local accounts of Zhongying Stone Pagoda in Xiaomen Village, for example, link its building with protecting the village. Each pagoda has its own history.
《神籙》的石塔是一位沉默的器物靈體。塔身、光紋與上場的動態屬於遊戲創作，並非某座: Shenlu's Stone Pagoda is a silent Spirit shaped from an object. Its body, glowing patterns and movement in battle are game creations, not a complete copy of a real pagoda.
石塔常與周圍地勢、道路或聚落方向一起被理解。閱讀地方故事時，也可以留意：居民當年: Stone pagodas are often understood in relation to the terrain, roads and direction of nearby villages. While reading local stories, ask which places and people the residents hoped to protect.
澎湖的石塔承載祈福、擋煞與守護聚落的願望，各地來歷不盡相同。《神籙》將石塔化為沉: Penghu's stone pagodas carry wishes for blessings, protection and safe villages, though their origins differ. Shenlu turns one into a quiet Spirit standing firmly beside its companions.
鍾馗提劍守在夜色與燈火之間。民間以他的威嚴形象寄託驅邪避煞、守護平安的心願。: Sword in hand, Zhong Kui stands between night and lamplight. People turn to his commanding image with hopes of driving away evil and keeping life safe.
臺灣的跳鍾馗結合宗教儀式與表演傳統，部分傳承使用懸絲傀儡演出。祈福、除煞等意涵，: Taiwan's Zhong Kui ritual performances bring together religious practice and theater. Some traditions use string puppets. Their prayers for blessings and removing harm express people's hopes for a settled life.
《神籙》的鍾馗以持劍蓄勢的靈體形象出場，是沒有特殊效果的融合靈體。驅邪意象屬於角: In Shenlu, Zhong Kui appears as a Spirit ready with his sword, a Fusion Spirit with no special effects. Exorcism is part of his presentation, not an added power to banish, destroy, shield or gain other abilities.

In Shenlu, Zhong Kui appears as a Spirit ready with his sword, a Fusion Spirit with no special effects. Exorcism is part of his presentation, not an added power to banish, destroy, shield or gain other abilities.
跳鍾馗的呈現方式依傳承而異。認識這項文化時，可以一同觀察操偶技藝、角色身段與地方: Zhong Kui performances vary by tradition. Look at the puppetry, the character's movements and local blessing rituals together to see how faith and performance meet.
鍾馗以持劍驅邪的威嚴形象受到民間敬重。台灣的跳鍾馗也結合儀式與表演，讓人們將除煞: Zhong Kui is honored for his commanding image as a sword-bearing exorcist. Taiwan's ritual performances join faith and theater, carrying people's hopes to remove harm and welcome blessings.
五府千歲是共同受到敬奉的王爺群體。本作以吳府千歲一位代表出場，讓玩家能清楚看見帶: The Five Royal Lords are a group of deities worshipped together. The game places Lord Wu at the front as their single representative, giving players a clear figure leading the defense.
南鯤鯓代天府主祀李、池、吳、朱、范五府千歲，是台灣重要的王爺信仰中心。廟方傳承中: Nankunshen Daitian Temple chiefly worships the Five Royal Lords Li, Chi, Wu, Zhu and Fan, and is a major center of Taiwan's Wangye faith. Temple traditions also tell of a ritual boat drifting ashore and residents welcoming the gods and building a temple.
《神籙》由吳府千歲領陣，其餘四府以旗幟與徽記呼應。祂站在眾人前方，帶領同伴守住陣: In Shenlu, Lord Wu leads while flags and emblems stand for the other four lords. He guides companions in holding their formation. This is the game's staging, not a claim that real worship honors only one lord.
看見「五府」時，可以把它理解為共同守護的群體。遊戲只讓一位代表站到前方，保留的是: The name Five Royal Lords refers to a group protecting together. Only one representative steps forward in the game, while their connection remains part of the image.
南鯤鯓代天府供奉李、池、吳、朱、范五府千歲，承載地方的平安祈願。《神籙》由吳府千: Nankunshen Daitian Temple worships the Five Royal Lords Li, Chi, Wu, Zhu and Fan, carrying local prayers for peace. In Shenlu, Lord Wu represents them, with the other four echoed in flags and emblems.
玄天上帝也被稱為帝爺公、上帝公。長髮、寶劍與龜蛇，是許多人認識這位神祇時最鮮明的: Xuantian Shangdi is also known as Diye Gong and Shangdi Gong. Long hair, a treasured sword, and the tortoise and serpent are some of his best-known features.
玄天上帝的信仰與北方玄武星宿相關。常見造像手持七星劍、腳踏龜蛇，也有戴冠端坐的樣: Xuantian Shangdi's worship is linked to the northern Xuanwu constellations. He is often shown with a Seven-Star Sword and a tortoise and serpent beneath his feet, or seated with a crown. These forms preserve different legends.
《神籙》以玄甲、長劍與龜蛇意象呈現祂的威儀。上場的光影與戰鬥能力是遊戲創作，重點: Shenlu presents his dignity through dark armor, a long sword, and tortoise and serpent imagery. The light and combat powers are game creations, emphasizing a steady formation and courage before strong enemies.
同一位神祇不一定只有一種外觀。欣賞玄天上帝的神像時，可以比較衣冠、髮型與龜蛇的位: A deity need not have just one appearance. Compare Xuantian Shangdi statues' clothing, headwear, hair and the positions of the tortoise and serpent to see how craftspeople express his divine character.
玄天上帝也稱帝爺公、上帝公，長髮、寶劍與龜蛇是常見的造像特色。《神籙》以這些意象: Also called Diye Gong and Shangdi Gong, Xuantian Shangdi is often shown with long hair, a sword, and a tortoise and serpent. Shenlu uses these images for his calm authority in the face of powerful foes.
沿途有人接應，長路便不再只是孤身前進。: With support along the way, a long journey no longer means walking alone.
阿澤把同伴留下的回應接成一條路，讓需要援手的地方，再次迎來熟悉的身影。: A-Ze joins the answers his companions leave into a path, bringing familiar faces back to places that need a helping hand.
這張卡的名稱與情節屬於《神籙》的遊戲設定，以旅途中的接應、守護與判斷為靈感。實際: This card's name and story belong to Shenlu's fictional setting, inspired by support, protection and judgment during a journey. For how to use it, open Effect Summary.
走過香煙升起的巷口，先認清腳下的路。: Pass the incense-filled alley and first be sure of the path under your feet.
尋路不是追逐最響亮的呼喚，而是先找到能讓同伴立足的地方。: Finding the way is not chasing the loudest call, but finding somewhere your companions can stand first.
一聲請援，向四方傳去。: A call for aid travels in every direction.
神籙翻開新的頁面，讓彼此願意照應的靈體聽見呼喚；援手是否趕得上，也要看眼前的準備: Shenlu opens a new page, letting Spirits willing to help each other hear the call. Whether help arrives in time also depends on the preparations made here and now.
廟前的空地，是出發與歸來相遇的地方。: The open ground before the temple is where departures and homecomings meet.
在阿澤的旅程裡，廟埕留下熟悉的香煙與腳步聲。只要記住出發的位置，就還有回家的方向: In A-Ze's journey, the temple courtyard holds familiar incense and footsteps. Remember where you started, and you still have a direction home.
一戶燈火連著另一戶，便成了可以互相照應的聚落。: One home's lamplight joins another's, forming a village where people look after one another.
《神籙》把鄰里相助的心意化成招援的場景。有人願意先伸出手，便有人能及時趕來。: Shenlu turns neighbors' care for each other into a scene of calling for help. When someone reaches out first, another can arrive in time.
彎曲的山路藏著未知，也需要同伴互相提醒。: A winding mountain path hides the unknown and asks companions to keep warning and guiding each other.
阿澤不再只顧著往前追。他開始留意誰落在後面，讓隊伍在狹窄的路上仍能彼此照應。: A-Ze no longer thinks only of chasing ahead. He starts noticing who has fallen behind, keeping the group together even on narrow paths.
先留下準備，下一次才有轉機。: Prepare something now, and the next chance may open.
神籙將暫時用不到的線索留在可找回的位置。眼前沒有立刻出手，也可以是為同伴鋪路。: Shenlu keeps clues not needed yet where they can be found again. Choosing not to act immediately can still prepare a way for companions.
局勢改變時，腳下的路也能重新選擇。: When the situation changes, you can choose a new path under your feet.
阿澤學著在不同場景間尋找立足點。這張卡把臨場調整的判斷，化成重新布置環境的力量。: A-Ze learns to find his footing in different surroundings. This card turns quick judgment into the power to reshape the setting.
看清攔路的障礙，才知道該從哪裡打開缺口。: See the obstacle clearly to know where to make an opening.
神籙的光沿著符紋展開，為同伴照出前進的方向。它象徵的是辨認威脅後的果斷行動。: Shenlu's light spreads along the talisman's patterns, showing companions the way forward. It stands for decisive action after recognizing the threat.
不同力量願意回應，才能走向同一個方向。: Different strengths must be willing to answer one another before they can move in the same direction.
這張卡描寫靈體彼此呼應、共同請援的時刻。名字與畫面是遊戲創作，不對應特定民間儀式: This card shows Spirits responding to one another and calling for aid together. Its name and image are game creations, not a specific folk ritual.
守住一段路，也是在守住後面的人。: Keeping a path safe also protects those following behind.
隊伍沿途留下照應，當威脅靠近時，便有人能站出來接應。這是《神籙》對巡守的想像。: The group leaves support along its route, so someone can step forward when danger approaches. This is Shenlu's image of keeping watch.
同伴遭遇危險，分散的力量便再次聚集。: When a companion faces danger, scattered strength gathers again.
這張卡描寫護送途中互相支援的場景。護駕不只有走在前方，也包括在需要時回身接住同伴: This card depicts mutual support during an escort. Protecting someone is not only walking ahead, but turning back to catch a companion when needed.
不是每道阻攔都為了困住人，也能是保護同伴的界線。: A barrier need not trap someone. It can be a line that keeps companions safe.
阿澤逐漸學會判斷何時前進、何時先擋住威脅。這張卡把及時守住缺口的決心化成一道防線: A-Ze learns when to advance and when to block danger first. This card turns the resolve to close a gap in time into a line of defense.
陸羽是唐代茶學家，以《茶經》整理茶的知識，被後世尊為茶聖。《神籙》讓茶香伴隨他的: Lu Yu was a Tang-dynasty tea scholar whose Classic of Tea gathered knowledge about tea. Later generations honored him as the Sage of Tea. In Shenlu, tea's aroma follows him, bringing a calm moment to a tense journey.
花婆與花公同受民間敬奉，照料象徵生命的花樹，寄託孩子平安成長的願望。《神籙》延續: Flower Granny is worshipped together with Flower Grandfather, tending flower trees that symbolize life and hopes for children's safe growth. Shenlu carries on that care, placing her beside the companions guarding the altar.
護壇雲豹是《神籙》創作的守護靈體，以雲豹為形象。牠安靜留意四周，在危險逼近時挺身: Altar-Guarding Clouded Leopard is an original guardian Spirit in Shenlu, based on the clouded leopard. It quietly watches its surroundings, steps up when danger comes and travels unknown roads with its companions.
土地婆是民間信仰中土地公的配偶。《神籙》以親近鄉土的守護者形象描繪她，讓她在隊伍: Tudipo is the wife of Tudigong in folk belief. Shenlu portrays her as a guardian close to local life, watching over every companion as the group comes and goes.
林紗娘與陳靖姑、李三娘合稱三奶夫人，承載民間護佑婦幼的祈願。《神籙》延續相互照應: Lin Shaniang, Chen Jinggu and Li Sanniang are known together as the Three Ladies, carrying prayers for women and children. Shenlu continues their theme of mutual care, with Lin Shaniang standing beside the altar guardians.
李三娘是三奶夫人之一，與陳靖姑、林紗娘一同受到敬奉，寄託婦幼平安的願望。《神籙》: Li Sanniang is one of the Three Ladies, worshipped with Chen Jinggu and Lin Shaniang in hopes of safety for women and children. In Shenlu, she and her companions support one another to keep the journey safe.
陳靖姑尊稱臨水夫人，民間向祂祈求產婦與孩童平安。祂也與林紗娘、李三娘合稱三奶夫人: Chen Jinggu is honored as Lady Linshui. People pray to her for the safety of women in childbirth and children. With Lin Shaniang and Li Sanniang, she is one of the Three Ladies, holding families' hopes for new life across generations.
九天玄女是道教與民間信仰中的女神，傳說曾傳授兵法、協助黃帝。《神籙》以軍略為她的: Jiutian Xuannu is a goddess of Taoist and folk belief, said to have taught military strategy and aided the Yellow Emperor. Shenlu makes strategy her defining role, guiding companions when to advance, retreat and support one another.
西王母又稱瑤池金母、王母娘娘，蟠桃與群仙祝壽是相關傳說的鮮明意象。人們向祂祈福祝: The Queen Mother of the West is also called Yaochi Jinmu and Wangmu Niangniang. Sacred peaches and immortals gathering to celebrate her birthday are familiar images in her legends. People pray to her for blessings and long life; Shenlu presents her dignity through the Jade Pond.
沙悟淨是《西遊記》中唐三藏的徒弟，原在流沙河等待取經人。加入隊伍後，他一路護持師: Sha Wujing is Tang Sanzang's disciple in Journey to the West. He first waited for the scripture pilgrim at the Flowing Sands River. After joining, he steadily protected his master as a reliable companion.
白龍馬原是《西遊記》中的龍王之子，後來化為白馬，馱著唐三藏西行。牠少有言語，卻陪: The White Dragon Horse was a dragon king's son in Journey to the West. He became a white horse to carry Tang Sanzang westward. He speaks little, but stays with the pilgrims throughout their long journey.
豬八戒是《西遊記》中使九齒釘耙的取經伙伴。他貪吃、愛抱怨，也會在危急時揮耙助陣，: Zhu Bajie is the Journey to the West pilgrim who wields a nine-toothed rake. He loves food and complaints, but also swings his rake to help in danger, bringing laughter to a difficult journey.
沙布提俑是古埃及墓葬中的小人像，人們相信它能在來世代替亡者勞作。小小身軀承載著對: Shabti figurines were small figures placed in ancient Egyptian tombs. People believed they could do work for the dead in the afterlife. Their small bodies held hopes and ideas about life after death.
貝斯是古埃及守護家庭的神祇，常以矮壯而威嚴的模樣出現。人們向祂祈求驅除邪祟，也盼: Bes is an ancient Egyptian guardian of the home, often shown as short, sturdy and commanding. People prayed for him to drive away evil and keep mothers and children safe.
塔沃瑞特是守護孕婦與新生兒的女神，常帶有河馬的外形。古埃及人將祂的形象做成護符，: Taweret is a goddess who protects pregnant women and newborns, often with hippopotamus features. Ancient Egyptians made amulets in her image as a wish for safe childbirth.
巴絲特是古埃及的貓形女神，與守護及生育信仰相連。祂的貓首形象廣見於雕像與護符，表: Bastet is an ancient Egyptian cat goddess linked to protection and fertility beliefs. Her cat-headed figure appears widely in statues and amulets, expressing people's prayers for safety.
托特是古埃及掌管智慧與書寫的神祇，常以朱鷺首或狒狒形象出現。在神話中，祂也曾協助: Thoth is the ancient Egyptian god of wisdom and writing, often shown with an ibis head or as a baboon. In myth, he also helped restore Horus's wounded eye.
阿努比斯是古埃及守護亡者與墓地的神祇，常呈胡狼首人身。祂與遺體保存及死後審判相連: Anubis is the ancient Egyptian guardian of the dead and tombs, often shown with a jackal head and human body. Associated with preserving bodies and judgment after death, he accompanies the dead toward the afterlife.
阿努比斯是古埃及守護亡者與棄牌區的神祇，常呈胡狼首人身。祂與遺體保存及死後審判相: Anubis is the ancient Egyptian guardian of the dead and tombs, often shown with a jackal head and human body. Associated with preserving bodies and judgment after death, he accompanies the dead toward the afterlife.
荷魯斯是與天空及王權相連的鷹神，也是伊西絲與歐西里斯之子。祂受傷後復原的眼睛，成: Horus is a falcon god linked to the sky and kingship, and the son of Isis and Osiris. His eye, healed after an injury, became a common protective symbol in ancient Egypt.
伊西絲是古埃及重要的女神，也是荷魯斯的母親。神話中的祂以智慧與法術守護家人，並努: Isis is an important ancient Egyptian goddess and the mother of Horus. In myth, she protects her family with wisdom and magic and works to recover her husband Osiris.
歐西里斯是古埃及掌管冥界與再生的神祇，常以裹身的王者形象出現。祂的遭遇與復生故事: Osiris is the ancient Egyptian god of the underworld and renewal, often shown as a wrapped king. His suffering and return to life carry people's hopes for the afterlife.
凱布利是與初升太陽相連的神祇，常以聖甲蟲呈現。古埃及人從甲蟲推動土球的動作，聯想: Khepri is linked to the rising sun and often appears as a scarab. Watching beetles push balls of earth, ancient Egyptians drew a connection with the sun's movement and life's renewal.
瓦吉特是下埃及的眼鏡蛇女神，常與禿鷹女神奈赫貝特並列。祂出現在王冠上的形象，象徵: Wadjet is Lower Egypt's cobra goddess, often shown beside the vulture goddess Nekhbet. Her image on royal crowns symbolizes protection of the ruler and the land.
奈赫貝特是上埃及的禿鷹女神，常張開雙翼護佑君王。祂與下埃及的瓦吉特並列，代表兩地: Nekhbet is Upper Egypt's vulture goddess, often spreading her wings to protect the ruler. Beside Lower Egypt's Wadjet, she represents both lands protecting Egypt's kingship together.
烏普瓦烏特是古埃及的犬形神祇，名字有開路者之意。祂的形象出現在王室與葬祭儀式中，: Wepwawet is an ancient Egyptian canine deity whose name means Opener of the Ways. His image appears in royal and funerary rituals, guiding rulers and the dead along their paths.
庫努姆是羊首人身的創造神，與尼羅河氾濫及生命誕生相連。古埃及神話描繪祂如陶匠一般: Khnum is a ram-headed creator god linked to the Nile's flooding and the birth of life. Ancient Egyptian myth depicts him shaping life on a potter's wheel like a craftsperson.
卜塔是孟斐斯的重要神祇，也是工匠的守護者。古埃及人將創造世界的力量與祂相連，尊崇: Ptah is an important deity of Memphis and a guardian of craftspeople. Ancient Egyptians linked him with the power to create the world and honored his wisdom and skill in making things.
塞赫麥特是獅首女神，展現太陽猛烈的一面。古埃及信仰既敬畏祂帶來災厄的力量，也向祂: Sekhmet is a lion-headed goddess who expresses the sun's fierce side. Ancient Egyptian worship both feared her power to bring disaster and sought her help with healing and calming disease.
阿蒙原是底比斯的重要神祇，後來與太陽神拉結合，受到廣泛崇敬。祂的名字帶有隱藏之意: Amun began as an important god of Thebes and later joined with Ra, gaining wide worship. His name carries the idea of being hidden, and he often wears a tall crown with two feathers.
拉是古埃及的太陽神，照耀大地，也與創世信仰相連。神話描述祂乘船巡行天空，日復一日: Ra is ancient Egypt's sun god, lighting the earth and connected with creation beliefs. Myths tell of him sailing across the sky each day, bringing light and the continuation of life.
拉塔托斯克是奔走在世界樹上的松鼠，往返樹頂與樹根之間。在北歐神話中，牠替雄鷹與巨: Ratatoskr is the squirrel running along the World Tree between its crown and roots. In Norse myth, it carries messages between the eagle and great serpent while also stirring up quarrels.
胡金是奧丁身邊的兩隻渡鴉之一，名字與思想相連。牠每天飛越各地，與穆寧一同返回奧丁: Huginn is one of Odin's two ravens, and his name is linked to thought. He flies across the lands each day and returns with Muninn to tell Odin what they have seen and heard.
穆寧是陪伴奧丁的渡鴉，名字與記憶相連。牠與胡金飛行各地、帶回消息，讓坐鎮神域的奧: Muninn is Odin's raven whose name is linked to memory. Flying with Huginn and bringing back news, he lets Odin in the divine realm learn how the faraway world is changing.
女武神是北歐神話中挑選戰死者的女性群體，並引領部分勇士前往英靈殿。她們的身影連結: Valkyries are the women of Norse myth who choose among the battle-dead and lead some warriors to Valhalla. Their figures connect battlefields, fate and the heroes' world after death.
伊登守護使諸神保持青春的蘋果。北歐神話記述她一度被巨人帶走，諸神便逐漸衰老，直到: Idunn guards the apples that keep the gods young. Norse myth tells how a giant once took her away, and the gods aged until her return brought their vitality back.
斯卡蒂是與山林、滑雪及狩獵相連的女神，出身巨人家族。她偏愛高山與寒地，與海神尼約: Skadi is a goddess of mountains, skiing and hunting, born into a giant family. She prefers high, cold places, while the sea god Njord favors a different home.
提爾是北歐神話中的勇武之神。諸神綑綁巨狼芬里爾時，他將手放入狼口作保，最終失去一: Tyr is a valiant god of Norse myth. When the gods bound the great wolf Fenrir, he placed his hand in the wolf's mouth as a pledge and lost it, leaving a story of accepting a cost.
芙蕾雅是與愛、美及魔法相連的女神，也與戰死者的歸宿有關。北歐神話描寫她乘坐貓拉的: Freyja is a goddess of love, beauty and magic, also connected with where the battle-dead go. Norse myth shows her riding a cat-drawn chariot and wearing a precious, shining necklace.
奧丁是北歐諸神中的重要領袖，追求智慧，也與詩歌及戰爭相連。祂曾付出一隻眼睛換取智: Odin is a major leader of the Norse gods, pursuing wisdom and linked to poetry and war. He gave up one eye for wisdom, and two ravens often accompany him.
古爾托普是海姆達爾的坐騎，名字有金鬃之意。北歐神話記述海姆達爾騎著牠出行，牠也是: Gulltoppr is Heimdall's steed, whose name suggests a golden mane. Norse myth tells of Heimdall riding him, and he is one of the divine horses named in the gods' stories.
夏爾維是跟隨索爾的人類少年，也是蘿絲克瓦的兄弟。他曾在巨人國參加賽跑，縱然腳程飛: Thjalfi is a human boy who follows Thor and is Roskva's brother. In the land of giants he raced, but despite his great speed, he lost to an opponent who embodied thought.
蘿絲克瓦是夏爾維的姊妹，出身人類家庭。北歐神話中，她與兄弟成為索爾的隨從，離開原: Roskva is Thjalfi's sister, born into a human family. In Norse myth, she and her brother become Thor's attendants, leaving home for a journey among the gods.
詩人埃吉爾是冰島薩迦中的詩人兼戰士，性格強烈，擅長以詩表達情感。關於他的故事，既: Egil the Skald is the strong-willed poet and warrior of an Icelandic saga, skilled at expressing emotion through verse. His stories include adventures and the grief of losing family.
史基尼爾是弗雷的使者，曾替主人前往巨人族女子葛德的住處傳話。這趟穿越險阻的旅程，: Skirnir is Freyr's messenger, who went to the giant woman Gerd's home to speak for his master. That difficult journey became a story passed down in Norse poetry.
海姆達爾守望通往神域的彩虹橋，以敏銳的視聽能力聞名。當諸神黃昏到來，祂將吹響號角: Heimdall watches the rainbow bridge leading to the gods' realm, known for keen sight and hearing. When Ragnarok comes, he will sound his horn in the gods' final warning.
艾吉爾是與海洋相連的巨人，也以設宴款待諸神聞名。祂的廳堂與宴飲故事，讓深不可測的: Aegir is a giant connected with the sea, also known for hosting feasts for the gods. Tales of his hall and banquets lend the mysterious ocean the image of a grand feast.
布拉吉是北歐神話中與詩歌及雄辯相連的神祇，也是伊登的丈夫。祂以善於言辭著稱，讓詩: Bragi is the Norse god linked to poetry and eloquence, and Idunn's husband. Known for skilled speech, he gives the poet's craft a place among the gods.
索爾是手持雷神之鎚的神祇，以力量與對抗巨人的故事聞名。祂常乘山羊拉的車出行，在北: Thor carries the thunder god's hammer and is known for strength and battles with giants. Often traveling in a goat-drawn chariot, he protects the gods and humans in Norse belief.
玉兔是中國月宮傳說中的靈獸，常被描繪在月中搗藥。皎潔月光與小小藥杵，讓牠成為人們: The Jade Rabbit is a spirit animal of Chinese moon-palace legends, often shown pounding medicine on the moon. Bright moonlight and a little pestle make it a familiar figure in the night sky.
哮天犬是二郎神身旁的神犬，在神魔小說裡隨主人追捕敵手。牠敏捷而忠實的形象，也讓威: Xiaotian Quan is the divine hound beside Erlang Shen, pursuing foes with his master in supernatural novels. His loyal, agile image gives the commanding deity a trusted companion.
唐三藏是《西遊記》取經隊伍的師父，角色取材自唐代僧人玄奘。他帶著慈悲與信念遠行，: Tang Sanzang leads the pilgrims in Journey to the West, a character inspired by the Tang monk Xuanzang. Traveling with compassion and faith, he faces trials with his disciples.
孫悟空是《西遊記》中從仙石誕生的靈猴，曾自稱齊天大聖。後來他護送唐三藏取經，以金: Sun Wukong is the spirit monkey born from a magic stone in Journey to the West, who once called himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. He later escorts Tang Sanzang, facing trials with his golden-hooped staff and transformations.
二郎神是民間信仰與神魔小說中的神將，常以三眼、持長兵器的形象出現。《西遊記》裡，: Erlang Shen is a divine warrior in folk belief and supernatural novels, often shown with three eyes and a long weapon. In Journey to the West, he matched transformations and magic against Sun Wukong.
觀世音菩薩以慈悲救苦的形象受到廣泛敬奉，人們相信祂聆聽苦難中的呼聲。淨瓶與楊柳，: Guanyin Bodhisattva is widely revered for compassionate relief of suffering. People believe she listens to cries of distress. A pure-water vase and willow branch often symbolize her in art.
太上老君是道教的重要神祇，與老子信仰相連。神魔小說也常描寫祂煉丹、持拂塵的模樣，: Taishang Laojun is an important Taoist deity connected with the veneration of Laozi. Supernatural novels often show him making elixirs and holding a fly whisk, with the calm, detached air of an immortal.
土地公是民間信仰中守護地方與田土的神祇，常以慈祥長者的模樣出現。村口小廟與日常供: Tudigong is the folk deity protecting local land and fields, often shown as a kind elder. Small shrines at village entrances and everyday offerings hold hopes for peace and a good harvest.
山鬼是《楚辭・九歌》描寫的山中神靈，身披薜荔、佩著花草。詩裡的等待與風雨，讓這位: Mountain Spirit, Shangui, appears in the Nine Songs of the Songs of Chu, clothed in climbing fig vines and flowers. The poem's waiting, wind and rain give this mountain deity a distant, moving presence.

台灣竹篙鬼意象；守林女妖與本關考驗為原創。: Inspired by Taiwan's Bamboo-Pole Ghost folklore. The grove-guarding enchantress and this stage's trial are original creations.

黑水溝、放水燈與王船意象；黑水娘及其身世為原創。: Inspired by the Black-Water Ditch, floating water lanterns, and King Boat traditions. The Lady of Black Waters and her past are original creations.

蛇郎君民間故事意象；假新娘、冒名婚禮與決鬥為原創改編。: Inspired by the Snake Husband folktale. The False Bride, stolen-identity wedding, and duel are original adaptations.

《白蛇傳》與歌仔戲意象；本關是原創試煉，小青並非惡人。: Inspired by The Legend of the White Snake and Taiwanese opera. This stage is an original trial; Xiaoqing is not a villain.

你聽見琵琶叫出自己的名字，神籙上的字也隨之沉寂。她邀你奏完最後一曲；你必須守住自: You hear the pipa call your name, and the words in the Shenlu fall silent. She invites you to finish one last song. Hold on to your own will to leave this deserted stage.
《封神演義》玉石琵琶精；夜戲、弦音封名與相遇為原創改編。: Based on the Jade Pipa Spirit from Investiture of the Gods. The night performance, name-sealing music, and encounter are original adaptations.

東北角霧海傳來沉船鈴聲，沉鈴娘喚醒披著船紗的亡魂。: A sunken ship's bell rings through the misty sea off the northeast coast. The Sunken-Bell Lady wakes the dead, draped in a ship's gauze.

《神籙》原創沉船怪談。: An original Shenlu ghost story about a sunken ship.
紅繩把前七段怪談牽回山路，她說：你想要的，我都能牽過來。: A red cord draws the first seven ghost tales back to the mountain path. She says, 'Whatever you desire, I can bring it to you.'
你以為終於走出霧路，卻看見一路遇到的幻影在她身後重聚。她提出最後的交換：交出願望: You think you have finally escaped the misty path, but every illusion you met gathers behind her. She offers one last exchange: give up your wish, or fight through her avatar and true form to cut the guiding red cord yourself.
《神籙》原創紅繩怪談；本關串聯前七關。: An original Shenlu red-cord ghost story. This stage brings together the first seven stages.
林徑炭火引來苔衣女子，她的尾影滑入樹門，護衛藏身於重重樹影。: Embers along the forest path draw a moss-clad woman near. Her trailing tail slips through a gateway of trees, while guards hide in layers of shadow.

北歐 Huldra 意象；樹門、護衛與相遇為原創改編。: Inspired by the Nordic Huldra. The tree gate, guards and encounter are original adaptations.

北歐 ellepige 與精靈舞圈意象；本關女妖與決鬥為原創改編。: Inspired by the Nordic ellepige and fairy dance rings. This stage's enchantress and duel are original adaptations.

北歐 Mara 夢魘意象；黑馬、夢紗與本關事件為原創改編。: Inspired by the Nordic nightmare spirit Mara. The black horse, dream veils and stage events are original adaptations.
湖岸女子梳起濕髮，漁網拉住倒影；傷害護衛的旅人被湖光留下仇印。: A woman on the lakeshore combs her wet hair, while fishing nets catch reflections. The lake's light marks travelers who hurt her guards with a sign of vengeance.

午夜運河傳來熟悉的名字，靛藍女子站在蘆葦間，水紗把渡燈引向河心。: A familiar name echoes over the canal at midnight. An indigo-clad woman stands among the reeds, her watery veil drawing floating lanterns toward the middle of the river.
有效場地可抵擋公開與暫鎖。: An active Field prevents the reveal and temporary lock.

娜達哈取材自埃及呼喚行人名字的河畔女妖怪談。本作讓她以熟悉的聲音引導渡燈，將思念: Naddaha draws on Egyptian tales of a riverside enchantress who calls passersby by name. In this game, she uses familiar voices to guide floating lanterns, turning longing into a reason to walk into the river.
你在運河邊聽見自己的名字，蘆葦後卻沒有熟人。她追問你最想再見誰，並以水影阻止你帶: You hear your own name by the canal, but no one you know is behind the reeds. She asks who you most want to see again, then uses watery shadows to keep you from leaving with your answer.
埃及 El Naddaha 意象；本關渡燈與相遇為原創改編。: Inspired by Egypt's Naddaha; the floating lanterns and this encounter are original adaptations for the game.
荒廢商隊營地亮起殘燈，沙金女子招來已散去的旅影，讓被擊倒的護衛再次踏出沙塵。: Fading lamps glow in an abandoned caravan camp. A woman in sand-gold robes calls back the shadows of departed travelers, and fallen guards step out of the dust once more.
效果破壞、回手、除外不觸發回收。: Destruction by an effect, returning to hand, or banishing will not trigger her recovery rule.

古拉取材自阿拉伯地區 ghoul 荒野怪物意象，本關設定為女性沙漠魅影。她以商隊: Ghula draws on the ghoul, a wilderness creature from Arab folklore, and appears here as a female desert phantom. She uses the caravan's fading lamps to call back the memories of lost travelers.
你以為找到可借宿的營地，倒下的護衛卻又從沙塵中站起。她將你算進下一支商隊，要求你: You think you have found a camp where you can spend the night, but the fallen guards rise from the dust again. She counts you among the next caravan and demands that you first cross this endless night procession.
阿拉伯 ghoul 意象；女性古拉、幻影商隊與決鬥為原創改編。: Inspired by the Arab ghoul; the female Ghula, phantom caravan, and duel are original adaptations for the game.
月下棕櫚河岸傳來鼓聲，翠衣女子身後留下異樣蹄印，護衛以堅固守勢逼近。: Drums sound along a moonlit riverbank lined with palms. A green-clad woman leaves strange hoofprints behind her as her guards advance in a strong defensive formation.
敵方能以守備力攻擊，優先處理高守護衛。: Enemies can attack using DEF. Deal with high-DEF guards first.
蹄足：敵方靈體可採防守攻擊，以守備力計算攻擊強度。: Hooves: Enemy Spirits can attack in Defense Position, using DEF as their attack strength.
艾夏坎迪沙取材自摩洛哥女性精靈怪談，並非埃及本土角色。本作採用美麗外貌與異常蹄印: Aisha Qandisha draws on Moroccan tales of a female spirit, rather than an Egyptian figure. The game contrasts her beautiful appearance with her strange hoofprints and places her in command of a riverside defense.
你循鼓聲靠岸，才發現女子留下的足印與人形不同。她以堅固護衛逼近，讓你看清優雅邀請: You follow the drums to the riverbank and notice that the woman's footprints do not match her human form. She advances behind sturdy guards, revealing the danger hidden in her graceful invitation.
摩洛哥 Aisha Qandisha 意象；歸入本遊戲埃及／北非路線，河岸守陣為: Inspired by Morocco's Aisha Qandisha and included in this game's Egypt/North Africa route. Her riverside defense is an original adaptation.
採珠港的香霧掩住船影，黑金女子翻起彎月刃飾，把擊倒護衛的力量化為仇印。: Scented mist hides the ships at a pearl-diving harbor. A woman in black and gold raises a crescent-shaped blade ornament, turning the force used to defeat her guards into marks of vengeance.
以效果移除手下可避開仇印；女妖離場解除降攻。: Remove minions with effects to avoid vengeance marks. The ATK reduction ends when the Enchantress leaves the field.
記仇：戰鬥擊破手下的我方靈體攻擊力降低500；女妖離場解除。: Grudge: Your Spirit that destroys a minion by battle loses 500 ATK. The reduction ends when the Enchantress leaves the field.
烏姆杜瓦伊斯取材自海灣地區女性鬼魅意象，並非埃及本土人物。本作將香氣與利刃意象編: Umm al-Duwais draws on female ghost tales from the Gulf region, rather than a native Egyptian figure. The game weaves the scent and blade motifs into the mist of a pearl-diving harbor.
你在香霧中尋找失蹤船員，她卻把每次反抗刻成仇印。你必須在港口幻景吞沒隊伍以前，看: You search the scented mist for missing sailors, but she carves every act of resistance into a vengeance mark. Before the harbor illusion swallows your party, you must see through the threat wrapped in her beauty.
海灣地區 Umm Al Duwais 意象；採珠港與仇印事件為原創改編。: Inspired by Umm Al Duwais from the Gulf region; the pearl-diving harbor and vengeance-mark incident are original adaptations.
紫晶宮廷的鏡面浮出獸影，紫金女王舉起王印，旅人的最強靈體逐漸衰弱。: Beastly shadows emerge in the mirrors of an amethyst court. The queen in purple and gold raises her royal seal, and the traveler's strongest Spirit slowly weakens.
及早解除女王，避免降攻累積。: Remove the queen early so the ATK reductions do not pile up.
化獸：每個敵方回合，我方攻擊最高的靈體攻擊力降低300；女妖離場解除。: Beast Transformation: Each enemy turn, your Spirit with the highest ATK loses 300 ATK. The reduction ends when the Enchantress leaves the field.
拉卜取材自《一千零一夜》中的魔法女王意象。本作讓她統治紫晶鏡宮，藉王印維持對來客: Labb draws on a magical queen from One Thousand and One Nights. In the game, she rules an amethyst mirror palace and uses her royal seal to keep visitors under her control.
你想借道離宮，她卻將你的力量視為王座的貢物。鏡中獸影隨每次拖延逼近，你必須在自身: You ask to pass through and leave the palace, but she treats your strength as tribute to her throne. Beastly mirror-shadows draw closer with every delay. Break free of her hospitality before it rewrites who you are.
《一千零一夜》魔法女王 Lab 意象；紫晶宮與力量侵蝕為原創改編。: Inspired by the magical Queen Labb in One Thousand and One Nights; the amethyst palace and erosion of strength are original adaptations.
幻夢宅邸裡的契紙與寶物逐一化煙，白金女子伸手接過來客的影子，直到夢醒才鬆開。: Contracts and treasures turn to smoke one by one inside a dreamlike mansion. A woman in white and gold reaches out for her visitor's shadow and will not release it until the dream ends.
敵方第六回合起定期暫奪最低攻靈體。: Starting on the enemy's sixth turn, she periodically takes temporary control of your lowest-ATK Spirit.
奪產：敵方第六回合起，每三個敵方回合暫時奪取我方攻擊最低的靈體，回合結束歸還。: Confiscation: Starting on the enemy's sixth turn, every third enemy turn, temporarily take control of your lowest-ATK Spirit. Return it at the end of that turn.
塔布布取材自古埃及塞特納故事的誘惑與幻夢情節。本作將她寫成接過影子、使承諾失去真: Tabubu draws on the temptation and dream episodes in the ancient Egyptian story of Setna. Here, she owns a mansion where she takes people's shadows and makes it hard to tell whether promises are real.
你在她的宅邸得到想要的寶物，契紙卻逐張化成煙。她要求你交出同行者作為代價；你得在: Inside her mansion, you receive the treasures you wanted, but the contracts turn to smoke one by one. She demands your companions as payment. You must refuse the deal before the dream ends.
古埃及塞特納與 Tabubu 故事意象；奪魂宅邸與神籙交易為原創改編。: Inspired by the ancient Egyptian tale of Setna and Tabubu; the soul-stealing mansion and Shenlu bargain are original adaptations.
綠洲水面映出彼此不同的身分，青紫女子將護衛藏入流沙與水鏡之間。: The oasis reflects identities that do not match one another. A woman in blue and purple hides her guards between quicksand and mirrors of water.
先處理後排，再試探隱藏靈體。: Deal with the back row first, then probe the hidden Spirits.
變形：女妖與手下採防守隱藏出場，受攻擊時才揭示。: Shapeshifting: The Enchantress and her minions enter hidden in Defense Position. They are revealed only when attacked.
西拉取材自阿拉伯地區可變形精靈的意象。本作以綠洲水鏡呈現不斷改換身分的女妖，讓外: Si'la draws on shapeshifting spirits from Arab folklore. The game uses the oasis's watery mirrors to show an enchantress whose identity keeps changing, making appearances an unreliable clue.
你在水面看見與岸上不同的面孔，她卻聲稱兩者都是真身。你要穿過藏在流沙裡的護衛，找: You see a face in the water that differs from the one on the bank, yet she claims both are her true form. Pass the guards hidden in the quicksand and find an exit that does not change with the reflections.
阿拉伯 Si'la 變形精靈意象；綠洲、水鏡與決鬥為原創改編。: Inspired by the Arab shapeshifting spirit Si'la; the oasis, watery mirrors, and duel are original adaptations.

你踏進無聲王宮，巨像與守姬便同時醒來。她以為你帶來了終結沉寂的答案；你必須穿過化: As you enter the silent palace, its giant statues and guardians wake together. She believes you carry the answer that will end its silence. Fight through her manifestation and True Form so the city gates can lead outside once more.
《一千零一夜》黃銅城女王意象；王宮甦醒與真身戰為原創改編。: Inspired by the Queen of the City of Brass in One Thousand and One Nights; the palace awakening and True Form battle are original adaptations.
